tools.notes: Creates an AMC cart (order) for one showtime through AMC's own seat and ticket pages: picks the seats, sets ticket types, re-checks seats, counts and the required expected_subtotal from preview_tickets immediately before Continue, presses Continue once and returns the cart AMC opens, which holds the seats for about 7 minutes. A cart listing other seats than requested is returned as cart_mismatch, to be released with cancel_cart. Refuses taken, wheelchair and companion seats (unless asked), unknown ticket types, preselected tickets, general admission, and a tab showing a cart or its edit page; it cannot see carts in other tabs. Never adds food, applies rewards, opens checkout or pays; the order token is not returned. cdp because the flow crosses three pages and the result is read on the last. AMC's security service (Cloudflare) rate-limits the ticket flow: after about five carts in a few minutes the order request fails with AMC's "Failed to fetch" dialog and the seat page shows a Cloudflare check, for an hour or more and across browser sessions on the same account; the tool returns rate_limited or challenge (site_error while the seat page still loads) after one press, with no retry. Independent QA on 2026-10-01 (live and source review) confirmed the cart, refusal, rate-limit (HTTP 429 with cf-mitigated: challenge) and cancel paths on earlier source. Builder live runs on 2026-10-02: a wrong expected_subtotal returned price_changed with no cart; the matching one created a $59.96 cart with a 413 s hold, which get_cart read and cancel_cart released. expected_subtotal then became required and the cart_mismatch check was added (fixture-tested only). Starting from AMC's 404 page in place of an expired cart is not cart_in_progress (fixture-tested). Independent live QA on 2026-10-05 of this source: refused without expected_subtotal; with preview_tickets' subtotal it created one cart (seats as requested, 413 s hold) and refused a second with cart_in_progress; the cart was released. Not re-observed in that run: the rate_limited path (observed live on 2026-10-01).
